newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mostly up in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mostly up in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly firmer in after-hours trade on Monday except for the benchmark July contract, as the dollar turned firmer against the yen later in the day, traders said.
The benchmark July contract was off 0.1 yen per kg from the day's close. Other prices ranged from flat to 0.8 yen per kg firmer. Volume was 3,017 lots.

The market started the day on a weaker tone, depressed by the yen's moderate rebound. "The market was basically directionless. There was little incentives to move prices, except for the currency market," one trader said.
